metadata.title: Part II Utilization and Bottleneck Analysis
metadata.description: Consolidated stage-level, source-level, bubble, and prefill PM results for the SF-MLA paper Part II.
notes: Part I uses DeepSeek FlashMLA as the decode primary method; Part II dense decode characterization remains TT-mainline mechanism proxy
decode_256~8k uses batch=2; decode_16k/32k uses batch=1
decode bubble metrics are interpreted as accumulated stall density, not wall-time share
prefill direct PM util is taken from sync_extra + repr_sync runs
A1/A2/A3 paired direct device-only probes now provide TT vs DeepSeek-4c representative-point device-side evidence
B/C/D paired direct device-only probes now show 8c mainly lifts the q-core capacity wall; already-fit B/C points remain 4c approximately equal to 8c
Existing A1/A2/A3/B/C/D device_only raw logs now provide reader+writer source-level direct evidence for completed TT / DeepSeek-4c / DeepSeek-8c cases

Initial A1 smoke runs exposed placeholder-only decode PM/perf-counter behavior; after adding SdpaDecodeDeviceOperation::create_op_performance_model and reinstalling the active runtime libraries, corrected-runtime representative reruns now provide non-placeholder decode PM plus FPU/SFPU/MATH counter columns for TT and DeepSeek-4c across 1k/4k/8k/16k/32k
Boundary corrected-runtime perf-fpu reruns now connect the densified 24q/28q/32q/40q/48q admission wall to the same seq=8k arithmetic-utilization axis
